description: Revert takt_auf_runner: disable the agent's runner schedule row(s) (session key takt-<agent_id>) and set trigger_mode back to server_job with next_run_at now (needs run_every_minutes and an active/provisioned agent), so run-agent-jobs runs it again via the tenant's LLM. The run_condition and the tenant's handoff settings stay as they are. Records an optimisation (art agent). Without ausfuehren:true only the plan is returned. Optional: grund. Admins (humans) only.

ausfuehren.description: true applies the revert; otherwise only the plan is returned
